description:
green_unmerged_sweep.py (PR #1633) and soundness_drain_report.py (PR #1635) now each carry an identical private copy of the develop required-lane classifier: REQUIRED_CHECK_NAMES, latest_check_run(), is_check_run_success(), is_required_lane_green(). They were fixed in separate PRs because #1633 was still in flight when #1635 was written, and editing it would have meant a conflict or a stacked PR (zero CI in this repo).

Extract one helper module alongside the existing precedent: both scripts already do sys.path.insert(SCRIPT_DIR) then 'from auto_merge_soundness_paths import any_soundness_path'. A sibling module (e.g. _project/scripts/develop_required_checks.py) exporting the constant and the four predicates fits that pattern exactly.

Note the two are NOT byte-identical in behaviour: soundness_drain_report.py additionally needs required_lane_green_at() for its park-time anchor, which the sweep has no use for. Extract the shared core; leave park-time anchoring with the drain report unless the sweep grows a need for it.

Both scripts currently pin their constant to the required-context block in docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md via their own unit test, so they agree transitively today; the extraction replaces that transitive agreement with a structural one. Keep exactly one runbook-parsing pin after the merge rather than deleting both.

preserves.behavior: Neither observer script gains the ability to enable auto-merge; both stay observation-only
Required-lane green stays fail-closed on a missing run in both scripts

verifications.description: Neither script defines its own REQUIRED_CHECK_NAMES

verifications.command: uv run -- python _project/scripts/green_unmerged_sweep.py --self-test && uv run -- python _project/scripts/soundness_drain_report.py --self-test
